hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.py) cd backend 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 | head -10 ;; esac; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); STOP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$STOP" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd backend && uv run pytest tests/contracts/ -x -q 2>&1 | tail -10; exit 0
